body.text: A small and frankly selfish request, which I set down after the rest of this month's news and not before it.
Life in {param:town} has become very hard. I have written to you about that and I stand by every word of it.

It has also become very hard for me, in a smaller way that I am aware does not signify beside theirs. There is no coffee. There is no decent candle. I am asking for {param:amount}, for myself, and it will not reach the town.
I tell you that plainly rather than dress it as a subscription for their relief. You would find out, and then you would not believe the rest of my letters, which would cost you more than the money.

tone.text: As to your own circumstances, I am {choice}.

options.label: send him the money
options.text: Draw what you need. A man reporting honestly from a bad place should not also be cold.

options.label: he can do without
options.text: You will do without, as they are doing without.
